About Organization

Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) is a government agency responsible for conducting recruitment exams for various government jobs in Rajasthan. The commission was established in 1949 and is headquartered in Ajmer, Rajasthan.

About the Programme

The RPSC Sub Inspector SI PET Admit Card 2026 is a recruitment exam conducted by the Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) for the selection of sub-inspectors in the Rajasthan Police Department. The exam is open to Indian nationals who meet the eligibility criteria.
